name: Direct Volume Rendering
aliases: Direct Volume Rendering (DVR) via GPU-based Ray Casting
Direct Volume Rendering via GPU-based Ray Casting
definition: Direct volume rendering techniques consider volume data as a transparent gel and simulate the effect of light travelling through this gel. Unlike indirect methods, there is no mapping; the whole dataset is passed directly to the renderer.
summary: Direct Volume Rendering is an image-order technique that renders 3D volumetric data directly without surface geometry, distinguishing itself through GPU-based ray casting within the fragment shader.
